LoginPasswordHeading: Sign in with username and password
LoginFailed: Username or password is wrong, or there were too many attempts. Please try again in a moment.
RegisterMethodLegend: How do you want to sign in?
RegisterMethodPasskeyHint: Face ID, Touch ID or your device PIN — nothing to remember, nothing to steal.
RegisterMethodPasswordHint: Works on every device. Best with a password manager and a long, unique password.
UsernameHint: 3–64 characters: letters, digits and . _ - @. Upper and lower case don't matter.
UsernameFixedHint: The username stays fixed as long as a password is set.
PasswordHint: At least 12 characters. A few random words make a strong password you can remember.
ErrorUsernameInvalid: This username can't be used. Use 3–64 letters, digits and . _ - @, starting with a letter or digit.
ErrorUsernameFixed: The username can't be changed while the account has a password. Remove the password first.
ErrorTooShort: The password needs at least 12 characters.
ErrorTooLong: The password can have at most 128 characters.
ErrorCommon: This password is too common or too easy to guess. Please choose another one.
ErrorContainsUsername: The password must not contain the username.
ErrorDisabled: Password sign-in is switched off on this server.
ErrorProofRequired: Please confirm it's you first: with your passkey, a recovery code or your current password.
ErrorLastMethod: The password is your only way to sign in. Add a passkey first.
ErrorTooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
ErrorNetwork: The server can't be reached right now.
ErrorGeneric: That didn't work. Please try again.
CardIntro: Passkeys stay the recommended way to sign in. A username and password are an additional way in — handy on devices without passkeys.
CardChangeRequired: This is a temporary password from the owner. Please choose your own now.
CardDisabled: Password sign-in is switched off on this server. Your password is kept, but it can't be used until it is switched on again.
RemoveBlockedHint: Add a passkey before you remove the password — otherwise you couldn't sign in any more.
ConfirmHint: With your passkey or a recovery code. If you signed in less than two minutes ago, nothing else is needed.
AddedInfo: Password added. You can now sign in as {0}.
ChangedInfo: Password changed. All other devices were signed out.
RemovedInfo: Password removed. All other devices were signed out.
RemoveConfirm: Remove the password? From then on you sign in with your passkey.
ResetIntro: For someone who lost every passkey and recovery code: give them a temporary password. Their devices are signed out, and they're asked to choose their own password.
ResetUsernameHint: This account has no username yet. Choose one:
ResetResultFormat: Temporary password for {0} (username: {1}). It is shown only once:
BrowserSignInHint: Sign in again in your browser to confirm. Your change is saved right after.
ErrorFreshSignInExpired: The sign-in was too long ago to confirm this. Please try again and finish right after signing in.
